prompt: Edit ONLY the short TAIL extending to the RIGHT behind this original wingless bird: remove every feather-like tuft,barb,fan,ridge or filament there and replace it with ONE short blunt smooth LEATHERY tail-stub contiguous with its wrinkled bird body. The bird must have ABSOLUTELY NO FEATHERS and NO WINGS. Preserve the original two feet,two eyes,beak,skin,airborne action,doorway,rain,light,composition and every other element. No new anatomy,text,watermark or glow. Do not remove or alter the two legs.

rejected_attempts.reason: Ekor di belakang tampak feather-like bercabang/berbaris meskipun tubuh tanpa bulu dan sayap. C06 mensyaratkan tanpa feathers; targeted edit tail smooth diperlukan.

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
